create_LoRALinear: create a LoRALinear module wrapping an nn.Linear with rank and alpha parameters
apply_lora_to_modules: apply LoRA injection to all named linear modules matching target submodule names in a PyTorch model
reset_LoRA_parameters: reset LoRA A and B matrices to their initial random state
toggle_LoRA_enabled: enable or disable LoRA contribution in a LoRALinear forward pass
get_parent_module: retrieve the parent module of a named submodule in a PyTorch module tree
